rules.message: Possible SQL injection — use parameterised queries.
rules.recommendation: Use parameterised queries. Never concatenate or f-string user input into SQL or shell commands.

rules.description: Warn on MD5/SHA1 for passwords (OWASP A02)
rules.message: MD5/SHA1 is weak for password hashing — use bcrypt or argon2.
rules.recommendation: Use SHA-256 or stronger for general hashing, bcrypt/argon2 for passwords, AES-GCM for symmetric encryption.

rules.description: Block weak session token generation (OWASP A07)
rules.message: Weak randomness for session/token — use secrets.token_hex().
rules.recommendation: Use a cryptographically secure session secret (>=32 bytes). Rotate session secrets regularly.

rules.description: Warn on unvalidated URL fetch (OWASP A10)
rules.message: Possible SSRF — validate and allowlist URLs before outbound requests.
rules.recommendation: Allowlist outbound destinations. Block requests to internal IP ranges (RFC1918, link-local, metadata endpoints).

rules.message: eval() enables code injection — avoid it.
rules.recommendation: Never use eval() or exec() with untrusted input. Parse explicit data formats (JSON/YAML) instead.

rules.message: innerHTML assignment can introduce XSS — use textContent or DOMPurify.
rules.recommendation: Escape user-controlled content before rendering. Use framework-native templating (e.g. React JSX, Django auto-escape) instead of innerHTML.
